verdict.rationale: Qapita's cap table docs say it can 'model equity ownership' and give founders and investors a real-time view of ownership, which is a thin first-party signal of round modeling. Nothing documents priced-round mechanics specifically. The investor-portal 'scenario planning' line refers to fund administration, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented priced-round modeling, dilution calculation, option pool top-up, SAFE/note conversion, pro-forma ownership output, scenario sharing with counsel and investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors

citations.quote: Issue, track, and model equity ownership with Qapita's cap table management software.
giving founders, finance teams, and investors a real-time view of ownership
